title: Microsoft Purview DLP: restrict access to Fabric semantic models and lakehouses
summary: Hold: the briefing still says the Learn overview labels restrict access as preview, but the overview no longer does and Fabric's What's new page lists it as generally available. The roadmap, notice, licensing and documented controls otherwise check out; the creation path and PowerShell capacity qualification need small corrections.

claims.claim: Purview DLP policies support a restrict access action for Fabric semantic models and lakehouses.
claims.quote: DLP restrict access action allows you to block access to guest users or all users depending on what labels or sensitive information types matches your semantic models or lakehouses.

claims.claim: The action can block guests or all users.
claims.quote: DLP restrict access action allows you to block access to guest users or all users

claims.claim: Sensitivity-label matches can determine the restriction.
claims.quote: depending on what labels or sensitive information types matches your semantic models or lakehouses

claims.claim: Sensitive-information-type matches can determine the restriction.
claims.quote: depending on what labels or sensitive information types matches your semantic models or lakehouses

claims.claim: Fabric DLP already supported auditing before this action.
claims.quote: This is in addition to the ability already supported by DLP policies to audit and notify users via Policy Tips based on sensitive content within Fabric semantic models and lakehouses.
